user_prompt:
Please plan a 3-day Tokyo leisure itinerary for me, using public transit where practical. I am staying at Shinjuku Washington Hotel in Shinjuku.

Monday: I arrive at Seibu-Shinjuku Station at 10:00 and will spend about an hour there before starting the day. After I sort my bags and check directions near the station, I want to go to a department store in Shinjuku where I can do some shopping and also sit down at a cafe. I need to be at Shinjuku Washington Hotel for check-in at 14:00, which takes about 30 minutes. After checking in and getting myself organized, I want to visit a park in the Koishikawa-Korakuen district for a calm garden-style walk, then take a little time afterward to look back at photos and get ready for the next move. Later, I want to head to Shibuya for a place where I can browse shops and then have dinner at a restaurant.

Tuesday: I plan to spend much of the day resting at the hotel: unpacking, having a light lunch from snacks I already have, napping, checking messages from my wagashi shop, organizing trip notes, reading with tea, and getting ready to go out in the evening. For dinner, please find a place that works as both a bar and a restaurant, and make sure it includes delivery as a service feature.

Wednesday: After getting ready and organizing my hand luggage, I check out of Shinjuku Washington Hotel at 10:30, which takes about 30 minutes. Before my 14:00 departure from Suidobashi Station, I want to visit a shopping mall in the Asakusa district where I can shop and also have a relaxed restaurant lunch. Please make the timing realistic so I can reach Suidobashi Station by 14:00.
